comments.author: priyankadeshpande
comments.body: This looks like SQL injection: the table name is interpolated into the query string. An attacker-controlled migration name would execute arbitrary SQL.

comments.author: tomasnovacek
comments.body: The name comes from the checked-in manifest allow-list, never from user input, and the value is quoted via the driver's identifier escaper. Ran the query-scanner suite over it — clean (run 5520). No injection path; no change needed.
